stories.title: Man poses as IAS for marriage, plans to sell bride:Organised grand wedding in Gorakhpur, flees when exposed
stories.summary: A shocking case has emerged from Gorakhpur, where a man from Etawah allegedly posed as an IAS officer to marry a woman and later planned to sell her in Goa. The accused, identified as Pritam Nishad, managed to deceive the bride’s family with fake credentials before his identity was exposed. Grand wedding, heavy expenses The marriage was solemnized with great pomp at a marriage lawn in the Nandanagar area. The bride’s family reportedly spent around ₹30 lakh on the wedding, including ₹15 lakh in cash given as dowry. After the wedding, the bride’s father filed a complaint at the Cantt police station in Gorakhpur against the accused and his family. Fraudulent claims and fake proof The victim’s family, residents of Mohaddipur, came into contact with Pritam through a matrimonial group. He claimed to be an IAS officer posted in Manikpur. To gain trust, he shared alleged news channel interviews, photos of an office setup, and images with political leaders. Demanded money before marriage Although Pritam initially claimed he would marry without dowry, he later demanded ₹15 lakh before the engagement under the pretext of expenses. The family paid ₹10 lakh during the engagement and the remaining ₹5 lakh on the wedding day. Truth revealed after wedding On March 11, 2026, the wedding took place at Durga Marriage Lawn in Nandanagar. The next day, after the groom’s party departed, someone informed the bride’s family that he was not an IAS officer. When the family reached the address given by the accused, they found their daughter in a small room. The accused and his sister fled upon seeing them. Allegation of trafficking plan After returning home, the bride revealed that the accused was allegedly planning to take her to Goa and sell her. The family has accused him of being a habitual fraudster who uses fake identities and documents to deceive people. There are also suspicions of his involvement in human trafficking. Police investigation underway According to Senior Superintendent of Police Dr. Kaustubh, a case has been registered and an investigation is underway. Authorities have assured that strict action will be taken after verifying all allegations.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km jam in Mathura; PM Modi stresses to keep sea routes open
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi dials Iranian President, stresses to keep sea routes open The US-Israel-Iran war has entered its 22nd day. On Saturday, the Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with the Iranian President over the phone and extended greetings on Eid and Nowruz. During the conversation, he condemned attacks on critical infrastructure in the region, noting that they harm regional stability and disrupt global supply chains. 2. Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km highway blockade in Mathura, cops injured in stone-pelting Cow vigilante Chandrashekhar Baba, popularly known as 'Farsa Wale Baba', died after being run over by a truck in Mathura. One of his associates claimed that early Saturday morning, Baba was chasing a truck along with two companions after suspecting it was transporting cattle. 3. RSS urges UP ministers, MLAs to avoid controversial statements The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has asked ministers and MLAs of the Uttar Pradesh Government to improve their working style and avoid making controversial statements against the government. 4. BJP releases new candidate list for Kerala, Assam and Puducherry Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday released fresh lists of candidates for upcoming assembly elections in Kerala, Assam and Puducherry. The party announced nine candidates for the Puducherry Assembly elections. It also released the third list of 11 candidates for the Kerala Assembly polls. Additionally, the BJP issued a list of two candidates for the Assam Assembly elections. 5. Akhilesh Yadav joins massive Eid gathering in Lucknow Eid is being celebrated in UP today. Amid high alert, Eid prayers will be offered at different times at Eidgahs in Lucknow. More than 50 thousand people are offering prayers at Aishbagh Eidgah. Meanwhile, former CM Akhilesh Yadav, former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma, and Congress state president Ajay Rai have arrived. 6. BSc student's cremated in midnight in Varanasi The last rites of BSc student Surya Pratap Singh (21) from UP College in Varanasi were performed at 12:30 am. His father had insisted that the accused be killed in an encounter before the cremation. Police officials somehow convinced him. 7. Airlines warn of airfare hike, blames it on Centre Indigo, Air India, and SpiceJet have opposed the government's decision not to charge extra for 60% of flight seats. Airlines say that this move will force them to increase airfares to compensate for their lost revenue. 8. Sanjay Nishad targets 160 seats in UP election: Focus on Kevat-Mallah community votes Nishad Party is going to launch its election rally from Gorakhpur. After this, there will be 3 more mega rallies. The party wants to focus on 160 Kevat-Mallah dominated seats in UP. 9. Train coach restaurant shuts down in Lucknow A unique restaurant operating out of a rail coach near Charbagh Railway Station in Lucknow has been forced to halt most of its operations due to a shortage of commercial gas cylinders. 10. Asim Munir threatens Shia clerics at iftar, says ‘go to Iran if you love it’ Pakistan’s army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, told Shia clerics that those who “love Iran so much should go there,” a statement Shia leaders described as insulting and provocative.

stories.summary: Lucknow News: लखनऊ में एक युवक के साथ एक हादसा हो गया। उसे ग्राइंडर नाम के डेटिंग ऐप पर दोस्ती के बहाने होटल बुलाया गया। वहां जाकर उसके अश्लील वीडियो बना लिए गए। जब उसने मना किया तो उसे जमकर पीटा गया और 35 हजार रुपये लूट लिए गए। पुलिस ने इस मामले में केस दर्ज किया है और जांच शुरू कर दी है। पीड़ित युवक बीकेटी इलाके का रहने वाला है। उसकी मुलाकात ग्राइंडर ऐप पर अलीगंज के रहने वाले अभिषेक वर्मा से हुई थी। दोनों ने ऐप पर बातचीत शुरू की और धीरे-धीरे दोस्ती हो गई। अभिषेक ने युवक को होटल में मिलने के लिए बुलाया। युवक को लगा कि यह सिर्फ मिलने-जुलने की बात है, इसलिए वह गुरुवार को होटल गैलेक्सी पहुंच गया। यह होटल जीसीआरजी कॉलेज के पास बीकेटी इलाके में स्थित है। अभिषेक इसी होटल में काम करता है।

stories.title: Train coach restaurant shuts down in Lucknow:Manager says, 'No gas supply since March 3, causing daily losses of ₹20,000'
stories.summary: A unique restaurant operating out of a rail coach near Charbagh Railway Station in Lucknow has been forced to halt most of its operations due to a shortage of commercial gas cylinders. Since March 3, the restaurant has not received any gas supply, leaving most of its kitchen stoves non-functional. Only coal-fired furnaces and tandoors are currently in use, severely limiting food preparation. Limited menu, reduced workforce With only coal-based cooking available, the restaurant is now serving a restricted menu. As a result, half of its staff has been asked to take leave. Out of 14 employees, only 7 are currently working. Head chef Vijay Kashyap said that operations have been severely impacted over the past 10 days, making it difficult to prepare meals efficiently. Daily losses of ₹20,000 Restaurant manager Vimlesh stated that the lack of gas supply has led to significant financial losses, estimated at around ₹20,000 per day. “If we don’t receive gas cylinders soon, we may have no option but to shut down the restaurant completely,” he said, adding that all gas stoves remain idle. Customers turning away disappointed Once a bustling spot, especially during nighttime with heavy footfall from passengers and locals, the restaurant is now witnessing a sharp decline in customers. Most menu items are unavailable, leading to disappointed customers returning without dining. The limited food options from tandoor and coal furnaces have also affected the restaurant’s reputation and customer trust. Livelihoods at risk The crisis has extended beyond business losses, impacting the livelihoods of employees and their families. Chef Vijay Kashyap highlighted that many workers depended solely on this job for their income. With reduced operations and staff cuts, their financial stability is now at risk. Customers are returning disappointed Earlier, the restaurant was always crowded with customers. Especially at night, it was a gathering place for travelers and locals. Now the situation has changed. Most of the menu items are not available, causing customers to return disappointed. Due to limited food being prepared in the tandoor-oven, both the identity and trust of the restaurant are being affected. Uncertain future The management fears that if gas supply is not restored soon, the rail coach restaurant may have to shut down temporarily. With expenses continuing despite declining revenue, the key question remains: how long can the business sustain these losses?

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav joins massive Eid gathering in Lucknow:More than 50,000 offer prayers, several leaders present; police enforce high alert
stories.summary: Eid is being celebrated in UP today. Amid high alert, Eid prayers will be offered at different times at Eidgahs in Lucknow. More than 50 thousand people are offering prayers at Aishbagh Eidgah. Meanwhile, former CM Akhilesh Yadav, former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma, and Congress state president Ajay Rai have arrived. Islamic Center of India President Maulana Khalid Rashid has appealed to people not to worship on roads. The Eid moon was sighted in Lucknow on Friday. After this, it was announced to celebrate Eid in all mosques of UP, including Eidgah Aishbagh. The moon was not visible on Thursday, the 29th of Ramadan, so the moon was confirmed on Friday, the 30th of Ramadan. Follow the guidelines issued for prayers. Do not try to worship on the road. Maulana extended Eid greetings to all countrymen.

stories.title: Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km highway blockade in Mathura:Policemen injured in stone-pelting; crowd claims smugglers ran over him
stories.summary: Cow vigilante Chandrashekhar Baba, popularly known as 'Farsa Wale Baba', died after being run over by a truck in Mathura. One of his associates claimed that early Saturday morning, Baba was chasing a truck along with two companions after suspecting it was transporting cattle. After overtaking the vehicle, Baba parked his bike in front of it, but the driver allegedly sped up and ran over him before fleeing. Baba died on the spot. Crowd demanding an encounter As news of the incident spread, thousands gathered on the Delhi–Mathura Highway, demanding an encounter against the accused and blocking traffic. When police reached the site to clear the blockade, protesters chased them away and resorted to stone-pelting, leaving several personnel injured. Protesters also vandalised 5–6 police vehicles, smashing their windows. Firing was also reported during the unrest. Police later carried out a lathi-charge and used tear gas shells to bring the situation under control. Meanwhile, Yogi Adityanath took cognisance of the incident and directed officials to take strict action, stating that the accused would not be spared. However, Shailesh Pandey said Baba had stopped a truck on suspicion and was checking it when another truck coming from behind hit the stationary vehicle due to dense morning fog, leading to the accident. He clarified that no cattle were found in the trucks and warned that action would be taken against those involved in the violence. Notably, about 25 km from the protest site, Droupadi Murmu was present in the area and was performing parikrama of Govardhan Hill. The incident falls under the Kosi and Chhata police station areas.

stories.title: BSc student cremated in midnight in Varanasi:Accused called himself 'dabang', added 'mafia' to his name; college murder video surfaces
stories.summary: The last rites of BSc student Surya Pratap Singh (21) from UP College in Varanasi were performed at 12:30 am. His father had insisted that the accused be killed in an encounter before the cremation. Police officials somehow convinced him. After the postmortem at around 9 pm, police took the body directly to Harishchandra Ghat. An inspector himself accompanied the body in the ambulance. There, the father performed the last rites of his only son. On the way, some students protested against taking the body straight to the ghat, but the police dispersed them by using force. Earlier, police had arrested the accused student, Manjeet Singh Chauhan (21), late at night. After the murder, he jumped over the boundary wall to escape, during which he fractured one leg. He is being questioned at Shivpur police station. The incident took place at around 11:30 am on Friday inside UP College (Uday Pratap College), where a BA student, Manjeet, shot and killed Surya Pratap. A video of the incident also surfaced in the evening, showing Surya lying on the ground while Manjeet climbed on his chest and shot him. The motive behind the crime is believed to be linked to a ragging dispute and rivalry. While Manjeet is said to have a criminal mindset, Surya was academically bright. The two had been in conflict for the past three months. On Friday, the college principal had called both of them to his office, where they again got into an argument. During this, Surya reportedly threatened him, which angered Manjeet. Shortly afterwards, the murder was carried out. Dispute was going on for 3 months While Manjeet had a criminal mind, Surya was good at studies. The dispute between them had been going on for three months. On Friday, the principal called both of them to his office. They argued there as well. During this, Surya Pratap threatened to deal with him. This threat did not go well with Manjeet. Read the full report… First, know about the crime scene and subsequent events... It was 11 o'clock in the morning. Students were studying in their respective classes. Suddenly, BSc student Surya Pratap Singh was shot dead in the college premises. BA second-year student Manjeet Singh Chauhan shot him in filmy style in front of the principal and students. A student recorded a video of the live incident. After the murder, the accused fled after throwing the pistol in a garbage heap. After this, everyone had one question: why did Manjeet kill Surya? It was reported that Surya used to call senior students in the hostel. He used to rag junior students. Manjeet had complained about this to the principal. The principal had summoned both of them. On Friday, after meeting the principal, there was a dispute between Manjeet and Surya. In which Manjeet rolled up his shirt sleeves, at this, Surya grabbed Manjeet's collar while hurling abuses. At that time, friends intervened to stop the fight. Manjeet went to his home. From there, he came to college with a pistol along with a friend. He parked his Pulsar bike near the gate outside the college. Then, upon seeing Surya in the arts faculty corridor, he opened fire on him. He fell down, but Manjeet continued shooting him with the pistol. Manjeet's leg broke after jumping from a height of 12 feet After the murder, Manjeet felt that he would be caught if he escaped through the gate, so he jumped from the roof to avoid this. His leg broke after jumping from about 12 feet high. His bike was parked at the gate, but seeing himself surrounded, he ran towards the airport road, even with his broken leg. Taking a lift from an e-rickshaw, he reached Gilt Bazaar intersection and then turned off the phone. After this, he tried to get treatment after reaching a deserted place. After breaking his leg, he could not flee outside the city. Meanwhile, police pressured his family members for his arrest. Angry students created a ruckus in college premises After the incident, angry students created a ruckus in the college premises. They broke chairs inside the campus. After about 4 hours, the police got the college gate open. Students and teachers were evacuated from the college by forming a cordon. Three professors were injured in a student stone- pelting. Police dispersed the protesting students with a lathi charge. Meanwhile, parents fainted upon seeing the body of their only son. Father sat on ground after seeing the body Late at night, Surya Pratap Singh's father, Rishi Dev Singh, arrived in Varanasi from Lucknow. At the BHU postmortem house, villagers said to take one last look at your son, but the father couldn't gather the courage. Later, people helped the father have a final glimpse of his son. Father had said, ‘Will only perform last rites after encounter’ Father Rishi Dev Singh had said - Police should encounter that boy, only then we will perform our boy's funeral. Our boy talked to us yesterday (Thursday), there was no problem then. There was no fight with anyone. We learned that the principal had called to school for reconciliation, but we never thought our boy would be murdered. Now know about Surya Pratap Singh... 21-year-old Surya Pratap Singh was from Ghazipur district. He completed his education till 8th from Ghazipur. He came to UP College to study from the 9th grade. Since then, he has been studying here. Surya Pratap Singh was very talented in his studies. He passed 12th with PCM from UP College itself with first division. Then he cleared the entrance exam and got admission in BSc Mathematics here. Fellow students said that Surya Pratap Singh was very friendly. He kept himself busy with studies. After his BSc, he wanted to do research in MSc Mathematics here. His dream was to go into academics. Student Surya Pratap Singh's father, Rishi Dev Singh, is a driver at a travel agency in Lucknow. His mother, Kiran Singh, works as an assistant in a school. The student has two sisters, one of whom is married, while the other is unmarried. Surya Pratap had chickenpox 20 days ago, due to which he was not coming to college. After recovering, he had just come to college today. Case registered against accused Manjeet Chauhan The accused student, Manjeet Chauhan, is a BA second-year student. Manjeet is a resident of Chandmari in Varanasi. He already had a case registered under section 323 at Shivpur police station, while his associate Anuj also has several cases registered against him. Manjeet Chauhan, who gets into fights over small matters, is of an aggressive nature. He has a bad boy image on social media. He portrays himself as a mafia on Instagram. Manjeet Chauhan is also well-known in local police stations like Bhojubir, Shivpur, and Bada Lalpur. He runs an 1818 gang on social media. In his Instagram bio, he has written - Your respect remains only as long as it doesn't hurt my self-respect. Jai Maa Bhavani. DCP Pramod Kumar of Varuna Zone said- The accused student Manjeet Chauhan, who shot and killed student Surya Pratap Singh in UP College this morning, has been caught. His leg is broken. His accomplice is being searched for. Accused Manjeet is being interrogated.

stories.title: RSS urges UP ministers, MLAs to avoid controversial statements:Advises to improve working style coordination with party workers
stories.summary: The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has asked ministers and MLAs of the Uttar Pradesh Government to improve their working style and avoid making controversial statements against the government. A four-and-a-half-hour meeting was held at the residence of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday at 3 PM, where discussions focused on addressing workers’ dissatisfaction ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Those present included Deputy CMs Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, RSS Sah Sarkaryavah Arun Kumar, Bharatiya Janata Party state president Pankaj Chaudhary, organisation general secretary Dharampal Singh, RSS Eastern Region Pracharak Anil Kumar, Western Region Pracharak Mahendra Kumar, and pracharaks from all six provinces. Key points of the meeting 1. Organisation-related work is not happening 2. Atmosphere deteriorated due to MLAs' statements 3. Unity should be visible in RSS, Government, and BJP 4. Make nationalism an issue instead of caste 5. Commission to respond in court on Panchayat elections Core committee meeting to be held tomorrow The core committee meeting will be held on Saturday in the presence of CM Yogi Adityanath and RSS Sah-Sarkaryavah Arun Kumar. In the core committee, a future roadmap will be prepared based on the issues that emerged during the meeting of the Sangh, government, and BJP on Friday. Additionally, there will be deliberation on the upcoming cabinet expansion and the formation of the state BJP's new team. Ministers will also be assigned tasks in the cabinet meeting to be held on Monday.

stories.title: Sanjay Nishad targets 160 seats in UP election:Focus on Kevat-Mallah community votes; push for SC status ahead of polls
stories.summary: Nishad Party is going to launch its election rally from Gorakhpur. After this, there will be 3 more mega rallies. The party wants to focus on 160 Kevat-Mallah dominated seats in UP. The party will raise 4 major demands in the rallies. Most importantly, it will create an atmosphere for including Kevat-Mallah in Scheduled Caste from OBC. What political message does Nishad Party want to convey through 4 rallies? Is it easy to get Kevat-Mallah registered from OBC to SC? How influential are Nishads in UP? Read in this report... Learn why these four rally locations are important Gorakhpur. The Nishad Party was founded here. Party's national president Sanjay Nishad belongs to this district. Nishad Party got its first political success from Gorakhpur seat in the 2018 Lok Sabha by-election. This seat had become vacant after Yogi Adityanath was chosen as CM. Shringverpur of Prayagraj: Has the confluence of Ganga-Yamuna. A grand statue of Lord Ram and his friend Nishad Raj is installed here. The government has also built a Nishad Raj Park in 100 acres in Shringverpur. The largest population of Kevat-Mallah lives in the Ganga-Yamuna belt. Varanasi: Is PM Narendra Modi's parliamentary constituency. The political message of the crowd that gathered at the rally here will go far. A large population of Kevat-Mallah also lives in Varanasi and surrounding districts. Meerut: From Delhi NCR to this Ganga belt, Kashyap community lives in large numbers. Hastinapur is also near Meerut. The Nishad Party intends to expand by showing strength in this belt. What are the 4 major demands of Nishad Party 1. Include Nishad in SC instead of OBC: This was the very foundation of the party's formation. Even during the alliance with SP, Nishad Party joined with this demand. Then the alliance with BJP was also formed on this condition. In between, while being in the alliance, Nishad Party gave slogans like 'No reservation, No vote' and 'Implement Majhwar reservation'. Reduce 9% reservation from OBC and add it to SC. Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad says- Through four rallies in UP, I want to tell the Nishad-Kewat-Mallah communities that your rights are not being taken by upper caste people. Rather, your share is being taken by Leatherman (Dalit) and Milkman (Yadav). Sanjay Nishad further says - Through the rally, we will tell our community that census is starting in the country from May 22. This time there will also be a caste census. The first task is to get your family name removed from OBC and register it under SC (Majhwar) at point number 12 in the census register. 2. First right on riverbanks, ghats and sand contracts: According to Nishad Party, their community had fought against the British. Due to this, their ancestral lands were taken away. Our community lives by the river. Therefore, sand contracts should also be given on first priority, government can take royalty if they want. 3. Rights on Land: Sanjay Nishad says that previously village ponds and ghats were recorded in class-3. The Nishad community had ownership rights over these. But in 2007 when BSP government was formed in UP, these ownership rights were taken away. We got this rule nullified through court. During Mayawati's rule we had also obtained a stay order, which we got dismissed. 4. Benefits of Denotified Tribe Status: Kevat-Mallah and other castes have been declared as denotified tribes by the Government of India. They were to be connected to mainstream society by providing them 74 types of facilities. But in 2013, the SP government took away these rights as well. Sanjay Nishad says- "SP took away education. BSP took away livelihood. Until you let leaders of such parties enter the village, you won't get your share. Only when you drive them away will they realize their mistake. Whenever I speak about this in the house, leaders of both these parties try to suppress our voice." What does Nishad Party want to achieve through 4 rallies We understood from Nishad Party President Sanjay Nishad and two political experts how successful the Nishad Party will be in showing its strength through 4 rallies in UP... Dr. Sanjay Nishad says - Through the rally, we want to make our community aware and organized. The party has invited 100 people from each assembly constituency to all rallies. Along with this, NDA allies like Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party's Om Prakash Rajbhar and Apna Dal (S)'s Ashish Patel have also been invited to these rallies. I met CM Yogi Adityanath and invited him to the rally on March 22. Nishad Party has also demanded declaring a holiday on March 23 for Nishad Raj Jayanti. Lord Ram was born on Navami while Nishad Raj, who was 4 days older, was born on Panchami. It's clear that Sanjay Nishad wants to demonstrate his strength through this political gathering. Expert View Senior journalist Anand Rai says - The Nishad community has significant influence across different sub-castes from UP's eastern border to Delhi NCR. This community has become quite aware over the past two decades. SP had announced the inclusion of 17 OBC castes into Dalit category during the end of their rule. The Nishad community has long been demanding inclusion in SC. While there is still a year until the UP elections, the Nishad Party has already started preparing its ground. The Nishad Party is currently with the ruling NDA. In the past, Sanjay Nishad has also shown aggression to include the Nishad community in SC, but for some time now he has appeared quite balanced. Rallies mean pressure politics However, senior journalist Harshvardhan Shahi from Purvanchal raises questions about these events. He sharply asks what Sanjay Nishad needs to explain- They should explain these things to their community in these rallies. Apart from pressure politics while being in power, I don't see anything else behind these rallies. This time, the caste census will determine how many people belong to which community. After this, it will be decided who will be the inspector from that particular community? Is it easy to get Kevat-Mallah registered from OBC to SC? The Constitution only recognizes 4 categories - General, SC, ST and OBC. This community is registered as Majhwar in SC category at number 53 in the Constitution's list. Kevat, Mallah, Bind, Kashyap, Dhimar, Turaiha, Majhwar, Dhimar, Manjhi, Raikwar, Batham, Kahar, Godia, Gangota, Gangai, Beldar are its sub-castes. In the Census Manual 1961 also, Kevat, Mallah, Manjhi were counted under Majhwar SC, just like Mochi is counted in SC. In 2022, CM Yogi wrote a letter to the Registrar General of India asking whether Nishad belongs to OBC or SC. In response, it was stated that they are listed in the SC category in the census manual. The nodal department has to issue directions after taking a decision from the Ministry of Social Justice. Based on this, people of the community can register their name as Majhwar in the caste column during the caste census. Based on the Majhwar certificate, in 2014, Ramcharit Nishad came from Delhi and was elected as MP from Machhlishahr reserved parliamentary seat on BJP ticket. This clearly means that in many states, the Nishad community is included in SC. Now the Officer's Statement Census work director Sheetal Verma says - In this, self-declared caste can be given prominence instead of surname. However, the benefit of reservation based on the declared caste will only be available when the concerned Tehsildar issues the certificate for that category. How influential are Nishads in UP?

stories.title: Opium crop worth ₹40 crore destroyed due to rain:Wheat-mustard crops damaged in 25 districts of UP; farmers say we are ruined
stories.summary: Unseasonal storms, rain and hail have caused heavy damage to crops in UP. Wheat, mustard and poppy crops have fallen in the fields. In Barabanki, adjacent to the capital Lucknow, poppy worth more than ₹40 crores was destroyed. Farmers say- Our crops have been destroyed due to unseasonal rain. If it rains like this for 2-3 more days, we will be desperate for every grain. Wheat and mustard were ripe and ready. But the rain ruined everything. Looking at the untimely rain, the Chief Minister has asked all District Magistrates to personally go into the field. They should assess the situation and immediately evaluate crop damage in affected areas. He strictly stated, This work should not just be on paper but based on ground reality, so that farmers can get proper and timely assistance. In UP, it rained in 23 districts within 24 hours. More than 8 areas experienced heavy hailstorms. 'Dainik Bhaskar' reached the Barabanki district and tried to understand the troubles and pain of farmers. Read the report... In Barabanki, opium pods turned black, and seeds difficult to extract In Barabanki, we met farmer Indrajeet at the opium field. He was worried. When asked about his concerns, he said that we planted opium in November, and flowers came in March. Now the pods (fruits) had formed. They have to be cut and given to the government in April-May, but now there has been unseasonal rain in March. Due to this, the opium plants that have fallen due to rain and hail, their pods will start rotting. The grain will become weak. If the full crop is not received, loss is certain. Now you understand that the government has nothing to do with the impact of weather, because we will have to give the government as many crops as the quota set by the government. 3,000 farmers grow opium in the district, and all are worried Farmer Surajpal says that only in Barabanki are 3,000 farmers involved in opium cultivation. About 5,000 kg of opium is produced in one season. 1 kg of opium sells for ₹10 to 12 lakh. In one season, its business is worth more than ₹500 crores. Now the problems have increased due to the rain. We asked what happens to the damaged crop? They explained that Government officials come and make them bury the damaged crop in the ground in their presence. Mustard seeds fell due to strong winds, making it now difficult to extract We also spoke to farmer Vikram Prasad. He says, ‘I had sown wheat, mustard, peas, and chickpeas’. This time, there was a slight delay in sowing wheat. The crop was about to be harvested, but it rained. Now the wheat has fallen in the field. After getting wet, the grain will remain weak. The yield will be reduced. The mustard crop was ripe. We had not been able to harvest it yet, and strong winds caused the seeds to fall in the field. Now we won't be able to properly extract the mustard seeds. If it rains like this for 2-3 days, everything will be ruined. Vikram says, ‘Potato farmers have already delivered their crop to cold storage, so they have avoided the losses’. Farmers said, ‘How will we run our households after the loss’? Farmer Virendra Kumar says, ‘Hail with rain has caused problems’. The wheat grain has become wet; if there is more rain, it will be difficult to harvest the crop. Nothing will be usable; we don't get fair prices in the market, and we won't even get compensation for this. Farmers work hard for the crop, but what can we do when the weather turns bad? Not everyone gets the benefit of crop insurance. After the loss that has occurred, we are just thinking about how to run our households. Cucumber crop covered with polythene After talking to farmers, we reached Ramsanehighat. Here we met farmer Rajan, who says, ‘We had sown mustard in the field’. Today it rained with hail. We had harvested some mustard, but extracting seeds from what remains in the fields will be difficult. The adjacent field had a cucumber crop. It was covered with polythene to protect it. Here, farmer Priyanshu says, ‘The cucumber crop is waterlogged’. If the weather remains like this for 2-3 days, it will be problematic. Because then the crop will start rotting. Now learn about the damage caused by rain in other districts Now know why the weather changed suddenly Heavy rain due to a western disturbance becoming active According to the Meteorological Department, the weather has changed across the state due to the activation of a western disturbance. The weather will remain disturbed for the next 2 days. Winds will blow at a speed of 40 km/hour. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Singh said that due to the western disturbance, there is a possibility of rain across the state. After 2 days, its effect will start decreasing. In the last 24 hours, Mathura experienced the strongest winds at 87 km/hr. Wind speeds of 59 km/hr were recorded in Noida, and 57 km/hr in Agra and Bulandshahr. Maximum rainfall of about 6mm was recorded in Bagpat and Bulandshahr. How will the weather be for 2 days? March 21- Some districts in Western-Eastern UP may experience rain. Winds will blow at 40 km per hour. The temperature may drop by 2-3 degrees. March 22- Most districts in Western-Eastern UP will remain cloudy. Rain may occur in some places. Strong winds will also blow. Rain in more than 25 districts in 24 hours; maximum rainfall in Mathura-Aligarh, clouds poured in Bagpat

stories.title: Youth battles leopard for 10 minutes in Lakhimpur:Keeps punching it, later captures it by tying its leg with rope
stories.summary: A young man in Lakhimpur Kheri fought a leopard for nearly 10 minutes. He was going to his field when the leopard attacked him and grabbed his hand. Using his other hand, he forced the leopard’s mouth to the ground and kept punching it. During the struggle, the leopard kept trying to break free. When it stopped moving, villagers came to help and tied its legs with a rope. The leopard remained sitting in the field. A forest department team later arrived and took the animal away. The young man suffered an injury to his hand and was admitted to hospital. The incident happened on Monday morning in Devi Purwa village of the Dhaurhara forest range. Now read the full incident Ankul Bhargav, 30, a resident of Devi Purwa village, works as a farmer. On Monday morning, he was going to his field when he heard some movement in a wheat field. As he moved closer to check, he saw a leopard. Before he could react, the leopard suddenly attacked him. Third leopard caught in one month After getting information from villagers, a forest department team reached the spot and captured the leopard. Ankul was given first aid and then sent to the district hospital, where he is currently receiving treatment. This is the third leopard caught by the forest department in the Dhaurhara forest range within a month. Officials have appealed to people not to take risks if they see wild animals and to immediately inform the department.

stories.title: Aligarh MP sparks row with remark on Eid prayers:Angry over demand for Namaz in open ground; says shouting starts from 4 am
stories.summary: A fresh political controversy has started after a statement by BJP MP from Aligarh, Satish Gautam, during an interview with a YouTuber. His remarks about Muslims and government facilities have triggered strong reactions. MP claims Muslims getting most government welfare benefits Satish Gautam claimed that Muslims are getting the maximum benefit from government welfare schemes. He said the government is providing them houses, ration and gas cylinders under different schemes. According to him, Muslims are also taking the most advantage of facilities in hospitals, from AIIMS to district hospitals. Controversy grows after remarks about permission for Eid prayers During the interview, the MP questioned whether, after receiving these benefits, they would now “climb on our chests”. His statement has now become a subject of political debate. He also expressed anger over the demand to allow Eid prayers at the city’s Numaish Maidan. Along with this, he criticised the demand to shower flowers on people offering prayers during the festival. MP objects to loudspeaker Azaan during exam period The MP also raised the issue of Azaan on loudspeakers. He said announcements from mosques begin around 4 am and create disturbance for people. Gautam added that children’s exams are going on and such noise should be stopped. Satish Gautam has been elected as the Member of Parliament from Aligarh for three consecutive terms. His recent comments have once again drawn attention and reactions in political circles. I don't know what this Ramadan-Famazan is The BJP MP said - They (Muslims) have such a large space. During the Samajwadi Party's time, they encroached a lot. Now what do they need the Numaish Maidan for? Our Holi and Diwali are celebrated by going from house to house. People gather at their place, no one gathers at ours. Roaming in the streets, going from house to house, embracing this is how Holi is celebrated at our place. What festival are you talking about that comes at their place. I don't know what this Ramadan-Famazan is AIMIM District President said - Did they bring Numaish Maidan in dowry? AIMIM Aligarh District President Yameen Khan Abbasi retaliated against BJP MP Satish Gautam's statement. He said - I want to ask the MP if this land in Numaish Ground was given only for exhibitions. MP Satish Gautam's mother did not bring Numaish Ground in her dowry. This land was given by our ancestors. This land was given for exhibitions. Mangal Bazaar, which used to be held on Railway Road, why is the market being held at Numaish Ground today? Holi Milan, which used to be held in Gandhi Park, why is it held in Numaish Ground today? AIMIM had demanded Eid prayers be held in Numaish Maidan In Aligarh, the All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) had demanded that Eid prayers be held in the Numaish Maidan located on GT Road. Under the leadership of District President Yameen Khan Abbasi, workers had submitted a memorandum to City Magistrate Dr. Atul Kumar Gupta. It also demanded permission for showering flowers on the worshippers from a helicopter. AIMIM had stated that they would bear the cost of the flower shower themselves. If no Namaz on roads, then alternative places should be provided In the memorandum, AIMIM had stated that Aligarh has now become a Smart City. The city's population has increased rapidly. The number of wards has also increased from 40 to 90. According to government directives, Namaz will not be offered on roads. Their organisation respects this. Therefore, the Numaish Maidan should be made available as an alternative place. Even after Namaz is offered in two shifts in the Eidgahs of Shahjamal and Jamalpur, there isn't enough space. If Holi Milan happens, then Namaz should also happen Abbasi said - When Holi Milan, Dussehra, political rallies, and markets can be held in the Numaish Ground, then there should be no problem with Eid prayers once a year. Citing the examples of Gandhi Maidan in Bihar and the Taj Mahal in Agra, he appealed to the administration to make a decision in the public interest. Permission sought for showering flowers at these places AIMIM leaders have also sought permission to shower flowers from a helicopter on Eid day. They stated that they would bear the entire cost privately.

stories.summary: The love of Gorakhpur will always be remembered. I am very happy to meet you. Love is reflecting in your eyes. Seeing this reminds me the song from my own film... 'Dekha hai pahli baar, Gorakhppur ki aankho me pyar' (I have seen love in Gorakhpur's eyes for the first time). These words were said by Bollywood actress Madhuri Dixit who reached Gorakhpur on Sunday. She had come to inaugurate a jewelry shop. During this, MP and actor Ravi Kishan told Madhuri Dixit about Gorakhpur city. Said that this city is connected to culture and tradition. See 3 pictures... Fans groove to the song Dhak-Dhak When Madhuri Dixit arrived at the jewelry shop inauguration, she was welcomed with her song 'Dhak-Dhak Karne Laga'. During this, fans started chanting "Madhuri-Madhuri". A crowd of fans gathered to see her. People climbed onto the roofs of nearby houses. During this time, female students reached the hostel roof and welcomed her by turning on their mobile phone flashlights. MP Ravi Kishan said - Earlier even Bhojpuri heroines didn't want to come MP and actor Ravi Kishan said - Everyone liked it very much. Heartfelt thanks to respected Maharaj ji. This is Gorakhpur. This is called government. Where earlier Bhojpuri heroines were not ready to come. Today superstar Madhuri Dixit ji is coming here. Ravi Kishan said - I have an upcoming film with Madhuri ma'am MP and actor Ravi Kishan said, “As soon as people heard about Madhuri ma'am, I started getting calls asking to arrange meetings with her. Where is she staying? People have gone crazy seeing ma'am. He added, “We also have an upcoming film called 'Maa-Behen'.”

stories.title: Gas crisis protest turns dramatic in Kashi:NSUI tries making gas from drain, six booked; 70-year-old woman vents anger
stories.summary: The shortage of LPG cylinders in Uttar Pradesh continued for the seventh consecutive day on Monday, with long queues seen outside gas agencies across several districts. Many consumers said they were not receiving cylinders even after booking and had to wait for hours. In many places, people returned home empty-handed after standing in line. The situation has also triggered protests by political parties and student groups. NSUI workers protest in Varanasi, try making tea using drain gas NSUI workers staged a protest outside Gate No. 1 of Kashi Vidyapeeth University in Varanasi over the LPG shortage. During the demonstration, they attempted to make tea using gas from a drain to mock the situation. Police have registered an FIR against six people in connection with the protest. Long queues outside agencies in Kanpur Long lines of consumers were seen outside gas agencies in Kanpur on Monday morning. In Kalyanpur, people waited for hours with empty cylinders. Later, agency staff informed them that the gas delivery truck would not arrive that day. This led to anger among the waiting consumers, and some created a ruckus. Women express anger in Prayagraj In Prayagraj, women standing in line outside gas agencies criticised the government over the shortage. A 70-year-old woman said she had never faced such trouble before. “At this age I have to stand in line for gas. This government has troubled people,” she said. Another woman said agency staff were asking consumers to return the next day again and again. Notices pasted at agencies in Gonda Several gas agencies in Gonda pasted notices outside their offices saying cylinders would not be distributed because fresh supply had not arrived. Despite the notice, long queues of consumers were seen outside the agencies on Monday morning. Online booking system also facing problems Consumers in several districts said they were facing problems with online booking. Many claimed the booking numbers were not connecting. People said when they call agencies, no one answers the phone. When they visit agencies, staff ask them to book online, but the system is not working. Crowd gathers at gas agency in Mughalsarai A large crowd gathered at Anand Gas Agency in the Nai Basti area of Mughalsarai on Monday. Many customers complained about delays in cylinder distribution. Rustam Ahmed, a resident of Padav, said he had been waiting for nearly three hours. The agency owner said cylinders were being distributed but supply was slow because the warehouse was far away. Congress workers protest in Lucknow In Lucknow, Congress workers connected a pipe from a drain to a cylinder and attempted to make tea during a protest. The demonstration was organised by members of the student wing NSUI outside the Congress headquarters. They said the act was meant to mock a remark by Prime Minister Narendra Modi amid the LPG shortage. Akhilesh Yadav protests outside Parliament Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav protested outside Parliament along with party MPs. They raised slogans against the government over the LPG shortage and demanded immediate action. Coal prices rise in Varanasi amid gas shortage Coal prices have increased in Varanasi as people turn to alternative cooking fuel. The price of coal has risen from ₹22 per kg to ₹26 per kg. Local traders said daily demand has increased by about four to five quintals. Residents struggle as shortage continues In Prayagraj, hundreds of people were seen standing in long lines near Civil Lines to get LPG cylinders. One woman said she had left her sick sister at home to stand in line. She said she had been trying to get a cylinder for three days but had not succeeded. Residents also questioned government claims that there was no shortage of LPG cylinders. Samajwadi Party protests in Meerut The Samajwadi Party staged a protest in Meerut against the shortage of LPG cylinders and rising prices. Party workers accused the government and district administration of making false claims about adequate supply. Under the leadership of district president Karmveer Singh Goomi, workers gathered at Commissionary Park and marched to the District Magistrate’s office. Shortage raises concerns ahead of Eid Residents in Varanasi said the LPG shortage has increased their difficulties ahead of Eid. Nasima, a resident of Palikothi, said she had been trying to book a cylinder for four days but the booking system was not working. She said she has small children and is forced to visit the agency every day. Agencies ask consumers to wait for SMS confirmation In Gonda, gas agencies asked consumers to visit only after receiving an SMS confirming cylinder availability. District Supply Officer Kunwar Dinesh Pratap Singh said supply was being arranged for agencies facing shortages and urged people not to crowd distribution centres.

stories.title: Bank manager shot dead in Ghaziabad over leave dispute:Guard fires at his chest inside office, flees with rifle
stories.summary: Abhishek Sharma (34), manager of Punjab Sind Bank in Ghaziabad, was shot dead by a guard on Monday. He was a resident of Patna, Bihar. The guard had been asking Manager Abhishek for leave for several days. Guard Ravindra approached the manager around 1:45 PM on Monday afternoon. There, he had an argument with Abhishek Sharma regarding leave. Meanwhile, Ravindra shot him in the chest with a gun. Abhishek fell to the ground, bleeding profusely. People in the bank were gripped by panic due to the firing. Meanwhile, the accused guard fled the scene with another accomplice. Bank staff took the manager to Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital in Delhi on a bike, but he died on the way. A CCTV footage from the bank's gate related to the incident has emerged, showing the guard with his accomplice. Minutes after he fled, people were seen carrying the bank manager away. The incident took place in the Balram Nagar area, under the Loni Border police station. ACP Gyan Prakash Rai stated, The accused guard is a resident of Baghpat. He had a dispute with manager Abhishek Sharma over leave for a long time. Because of this, he carried out this incident. Teams have been deployed to search for the accused and he will be arrested soon. See 3 visuals Abhishek lived with his wife in Ghaziabad Bank Manager Abhishek Sharma was a resident of Lakhipur, Patna, Bihar. Since August 2025, he had been living on rent with his wife in Ghaziabad. His wife has been informed about the incident. Guard did not come on duty in the morning, arrived in the afternoon and shot him According to the police, guard Ravindra Hooda is a resident of Baghpat. He had got a job at Punjab Bank three days ago. He was often on leave. Even on Monday morning, when the guard did not come on duty, the bank manager called him. He reprimanded him, asking the reason for not coming on duty. Abhishek also told him to come to the bank immediately. Around 1:30 PM, guard Ravindra reached the bank with a colleague. He took the gun deposited in the bank. After this, he went directly to the bank manager and started arguing. Then he shot Abhishek.

stories.title: Dream of Korean pop takes Meerut sisters to Mumbai:Missing teens found in hotel; mother says they learnt 10 languages from YouTube
stories.summary: Two sisters who went missing from Meerut on March 10 were traced to a hotel in Mumbai after a three-day search operation, police said. The girls — aged 16 and 18 — have now been brought back to Meerut. During questioning, the sisters told police that they had travelled to Mumbai to attend an audition for a Korean singing talent show. According to them, they had already cleared the first round of auditions online and had been called to Mumbai for the second round. The case falls under the Shastri Nagar area of the Medical police station in Meerut. Police traced mobile location to Mumbai CO Civil Lines Abhishek Tiwari said the girls’ mother filed a missing complaint at the Medical police station on March 10 after the sisters left home in a car. “Police teams immediately began tracing their mobile location, which was found to be in Mumbai,” Tiwari said. A team led by lady officer Pooja Pawar, along with officers Chandrakant and another colleague, was assigned to the search operation. Chandrakant had earlier worked with Mumbai Police in a previous case and maintained contacts there, which helped the investigation. The team travelled by road to Mumbai and located the sisters in a hotel. They were brought back to Meerut on March 14 and have been kept at the Asha Jyoti Centre for counselling. Girls say they travelled for singing audition In their statement to police, the sisters said they had gone to Mumbai to pursue their dream of becoming singers. They told investigators that they can sing in about 10 languages and are strongly influenced by the South Korean music band BTS. They also expressed a desire to meet and work with the band’s singer V. The sisters said they travelled to Mumbai in their family’s Tata Punch car. As neither of them could drive long distances, they hired a driver through an app for ₹8,000. Their father died due to illness about a year ago. The family includes a younger brother who is still studying, while their mother works with Ayurvedic medicines. Mother had filed missing report The girls’ mother told police she became worried when she returned home on March 10 and found both daughters missing. She immediately approached the police and filed an FIR. Speaking about the incident, the woman said she was relieved that both daughters had returned safely. “I am thankful to Meerut Police for bringing my daughters back. I don’t know what I would have done if something unfortunate had happened,” she said. ‘They left without telling, but wanted to build their future’ The mother said the sisters had left home without informing her, but insisted that their intention was not wrong. “My daughters want to become singers. They left home without telling me, which hurts me. But they did not do anything wrong. They went out to build their future and spent their own savings,” she said. She added that the girls had learned singing on their own by listening to songs on YouTube and practising regularly. According to her, they can sing in several languages including Korean, French, Chinese and Arabic. Audition call from Mumbai The woman said her daughters had filled out the audition form for a singing talent show on their own and cleared the first round online. “They later received a call to attend the second round in Mumbai,” she said. Fearing that she might stop them from pursuing singing, the girls did not inform her about the audition and travelled to Mumbai using their savings and the prize money they had received after clearing the first round. However, before they could appear for the audition, police traced their location and reached the hotel where they were staying. Dream of working with BTS singer The sisters told their mother they aspire to become international singers and want to work with V from the South Korean band BTS. According to the mother, the girls hope to travel to South Korea in the future to pursue their music career. She said a singing competition they had applied for offered a prize of ₹50 lakh and a car. Police said the girls are currently safe and further counselling is being conducted.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav meets Salman Khan in Mumbai:Inquires about the health of ailing father, Salim Khan; shares photo on social media
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav met Bollywood star Salman Khan on Sunday. Akhilesh Yadav himself shared a picture with Salman Khan on Instagram. According to media reports, Akhilesh Yadav had gone to inquire about the health of Salman's father, Salim Khan. However, no official reason for this meeting has come out yet. Photo shared on Instagram, wrote - Mumbai Milan Akhilesh Yadav posted a picture of this meeting with the caption 'Mumbai Milan'. In the photo, both are seen posing together. As soon as it was posted, this picture went viral and received millions of likes within a few hours. Meanwhile, fans are making various speculations about the purpose behind this meeting. Salim Khan admitted to Lilavati Hospital Salim Khan was admitted to Lilavati Hospital on February 17th in the morning after a brain-related issue. He was brought to the emergency room around 8:30 AM. After initial examination, a special team of doctors was formed to assess his condition. On February 18th, Dr. Jalil Parker of Lilavati Hospital informed that Salim Khan underwent Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA). According to doctors, this is not brain surgery. DSA is an advanced diagnostic test that clearly visualizes the condition of the brain blood vessels and potential blockages. Old connections with politicians Politicians from different parties have had old ties with Salman Khan's family. Even before this, Akhilesh Yadav and many other prominent leaders have been meeting Salman and Salim Khan. Salim Khan is a veteran Bollywood writer, and ever since the news of his ill health, many prominent personalities have visited the Khan family to inquire about his well-being.

stories.title: Class 12 student killed during bike stunt:Bullet crashes into scooter in Lucknow; teenager thrown onto divider in collision
stories.summary: A Class 12 student lost his life during a bike race in Lucknow after his motorcycle collided with a scooter near Janeshwar Mishra Park. The crash occurred on Sunday morning near Gate No. 5 of the park in the Gomti Nagar Extension area. According to reports, riders on a Bullet and a Kawasaki motorcycle were racing when the accident took place. The student riding the Bullet crashed into a divider after hitting a scooter that suddenly appeared in front of him. He sustained severe head injuries and later died during treatment. See 2 pictures Crash occurred during early morning ride The deceased has been identified as Naitik Kumar (17), a resident of Vishesh Khand in Gomti Nagar Extension. His father, Ram Iqbal, works as an engineer in the electricity department. Naitik had gone out for a morning ride with his friends Aditya Srivastava and Krishna Singh. The three teenagers were riding separate bikes. At around 7:30 am, while passing Janeshwar Mishra Park, the trio reportedly began racing their motorcycles. During the race, a scooter suddenly came in front of Naitik’s Bullet. Before he could react, the Bullet collided with the scooter. The impact threw Naitik off his bike and he struck the divider. The collision caused severe head injuries. Aditya, who was riding a Kawasaki behind Naitik, also lost control and fell from his motorcycle. Krishna also fell onto the road during the incident. Victim died during treatment Local residents gathered at the scene immediately after the accident. With their help, the injured boys were rushed to a nearby hospital. Doctors declared Naitik Kumar dead during treatment due to the seriousness of his injuries. The other two injured youths sustained relatively minor injuries and were discharged after receiving medical treatment. Friend’s social media post goes viral While being taken to the hospital in an ambulance, Naitik’s injured friend Aditya recorded a video. After learning about Naitik’s death, he posted the video on social media with the caption: 'Everything ended in a moment.' The post has since been widely shared and is rapidly going viral online. Family refuses post-mortem examination Police informed the family about the accident and took the body into custody to begin legal formalities. However, the family refused to allow a post-mortem examination. They later took the body to their ancestral village in Barabanki for the final rites. According to Sudhir Awasthi, the Station House Officer of Gomti Nagar Extension Police Station, investigators are reviewing CCTV footage from nearby cameras to determine the exact circumstances that led to the accident. Earlier fatal accident in the same area The incident has also revived memories of another tragic accident in the same region. On 21 November 2023, Namish, the nine-year-old son of ASP Shweta Srivastava, was killed in a road accident while practising skating. Namish had gone out early in the morning to practise skating on the G-20 Road, accompanied by his coach and his mother. During the practice session, a speeding car hit him. The collision threw the child nearly 15 feet into the air, causing severe injuries to his head and stomach. He began bleeding from his mouth and nose and later died from the injuries. Questions raised over police checks Videos of motorcycle stunts and social media reels are frequently recorded and circulated from the Gomti Nagar Extension area. Although the police claim that regular checking drives are conducted to curb such activities, the latest accident has raised questions about the effectiveness of those measures.

stories.title: Rape convict Asaram gets VIP darshan at Kashi Vishwanath:Cops deployed to control crowd; continues preaching in Varanasi for 3 days
stories.summary: Self-styled godman and convict Asaram, who is serving a life sentence in a rape case and is currently out on interim bail, visited the Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi on Sunday evening under VIP protocol. According to officials and eyewitnesses, Asaram reached the temple around 8 pm in a luxury vehicle. He later entered the temple premises in a wheelchair through Gate No. 4, which is designated as a VIP entry point. More than 50 police personnel were deployed to control the crowd and escort him inside the temple complex. Darshan from outside the sanctum Despite entering through a VIP gate, Asaram was not allowed “sparsh darshan” (touching the deity) inside the sanctum. Instead, he offered prayers from outside the garbhagriha (inner sanctum) like other devotees present at the temple. During this time, regular devotees were also allowed to continue their darshan of the sacred Jyotirlinga. News of his arrival quickly spread among his followers, many of whom gathered outside the temple to catch a glimpse of him when he came out. Staying at Ashram, delivering daily discourses Asaram has been in Varanasi for the past three days and is staying at an ashram located in Anora village of Badagaon area. From there, he has been delivering daily spiritual discourses to his followers. During these sessions, the ashram administration has imposed strict restrictions on the use of mobile phones. Devotees entering the satsang hall are required to deposit their phones, and video recording inside the premises is strictly prohibited. If anyone is caught secretly recording videos, they are reportedly asked to delete the footage immediately. Thousands of followers visiting the Ashram Since news of Asaram’s presence in Varanasi spread, large numbers of his followers have started visiting the ashram. People have reportedly come from several districts of eastern Uttar Pradesh, including Jaunpur, Bhadohi, Ghazipur, Mirzapur, Azamgarh and Chandauli, as well as from the neighboring state of Bihar. Local villagers say the ashram, which had remained quiet for nearly one and a half decades, has suddenly become crowded with thousands of visitors and long convoys of vehicles. On Sunday afternoon around 2:20 pm, Asaram reportedly left the ashram briefly, although his destination was not disclosed. Earlier visit to Ayodhya’s Ram temple Just four days before arriving in Varanasi, Asaram visited the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya on March 11. He entered the temple through the Adi Shankaracharya Gate in a convoy of three vehicles and was allowed to have darshan of Ram Lalla under VIP arrangements. Temple officials said he spent about 10 minutes offering prayers and observing the idol of Ram Lalla. During his visit, he also looked at the temple’s ornate architecture, including its gold-plated doors and intricate carvings. However, he could not visit the nearby Hanuman Garhi temple because he was unable to climb its long flight of stairs. He remained inside the Ram temple complex for about 30 minutes before returning to Lakshman Kila. Why Asaram is visiting pilgrimage sites During his Ayodhya visit, Asaram explained why he had been travelling to different pilgrimage sites. He said: There are many pilgrimage places in India where merely visiting or giving up one’s life brings spiritual liberation. Scriptures mention seven sacred sites that grant salvation—Ayodhya, Mathura, Maya (Haridwar), Kashi, Kanchi, Avantika and Puri. He also spoke about traditional beliefs related to human health, stating that the human body contains three basic elements—vata, kapha and pitta—and visiting holy places can help balance them. According to him, scriptures place Ayodhya at the top among the seven sacred cities. Why Asaram was sentenced to life imprisonment Asaram is currently serving a life sentence after being convicted in a rape case involving a minor. In 2013, a teenage girl from Shahjahanpur in Uttar Pradesh, whose family were followers of Asaram, was studying at his ashram in Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh. One day she reportedly fainted in class. An ashram follower allegedly claimed that she was under the influence of evil spirits and that only Asaram could cure her. The girl was then taken from Chhindwara to Jodhpur, nearly 1,000 kilometers away, to another ashram. According to the complaint, on the night of August 15, 2013, a cook brought a glass of milk into the hut where the girl was staying, after which Asaram sexually assaulted her. Five days later, on August 20, 2013, the victim filed an FIR with Delhi Police, alleging rape and sexual assault. At that time, stricter legal provisions related to sexual crimes had recently been introduced in India following the 2012 Delhi gang rape case. Asaram was arrested soon after and prosecuted under these provisions. On April 25, 2018, a court in Jodhpur found him guilty and sentenced him to life imprisonment. Since then, he has been lodged in Jodhpur Central Jail. Interim bail on medical grounds After years in jail, Asaram was granted temporary relief due to health issues. The Supreme Court of India granted him medical bail until March 31, 2025, citing health concerns. Later, the Rajasthan High Court granted him six months of interim bail on October 29, considering his advanced age and deteriorating health. On November 6, the Gujarat High Court also granted him interim bail in another rape case. However, that order included conditions that three police personnel must accompany him at all times and that he should not meet followers in groups. Asaram later filed another petition seeking relaxation of these conditions.

stories.title: Weather takes a dramatic turn in UP:Snowfall in hills, rain alert in 43 districts; Muzaffarnagar gets hail, storm lashes Bijnor
stories.summary: The weather in Uttar Pradesh has suddenly changed. In Muzaffarnagar, heavy rain with strong winds occurred late at night, and pea-sized hailstones fell in many areas. In Bijnor, the storm uprooted trees and toppled roadside hoardings, while falling electricity poles caused power outages in several places. On Monday, an alert has been issued for light rain in 43 districts, including Varanasi, and hail in 17 districts. Storms may also occur in many areas. The Meteorological Department said the weather changed due to snowfall in the mountains and an active western disturbance, bringing cold winds and a drop in temperature. Earlier on Sunday, light rain with strong winds was reported in 15 cities, including Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, and Ayodhya. Lucknow witnessed a dusty storm with drizzle. In Hardoi and Sitapur, two people, including a farmer, died due to lightning, while three others, including two children, were scorched. Rain, hail, and strong winds have also affected crops, with standing crops bending in many areas. However, people got relief from the heat. In the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest city with a maximum temperature of 38.4°C, though it had crossed 40°C on March 14. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Singh, explained the reason for the change in weather. He said - Due to the Western Disturbance, light rain has started in many districts of the state. There are chances of rain in the eastern and western parts of the state on Monday as well. Winds will blow at a speed of 40-50 km. Hail may also fall. After 2 days, another disturbance will become active in the state from March 19, which will start a period of rain and storms. 4 weather pictures- Crop damage due to unseasonal rain Unseasonal rain, hailstorms, and strong winds are damaging standing crops in the fields. Farmers say that the wheat crop is currently in the ripening stage. In such a situation, rain and strong winds cause the ears to bend. This causes difficulty during harvesting. The risk of grain spoilage also increases. According to agricultural experts, continuous moisture can also increase the risk of diseases in crops. However, light rain can also benefit some pulse and vegetable crops. CM Yogi had instructed officers to go into the field Why is the heat increasing in March itself? Mahesh Palawat, Vice President of Skymet Weather, said the impact of climate change has become clearly visible on weather patterns in recent years, causing rapid changes. Summers are also starting earlier than before. As a result, temperatures are rising faster, the number of hot days is increasing, and heatwaves often last longer than earlier. In the past few years, many cities across the country have broken old heat records, with temperatures in some places exceeding 48°C. Heatwave could last for a long time According to IMD's forecast, some areas may experience prolonged heatwave conditions this year. This means that in many cities, temperatures could remain very high for several consecutive days, and people might have to face intense heat. When is a heatwave considered? According to the Meteorological Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in the plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or more, or when it is recorded 4 to 6 degrees higher than the normal temperature. In such a situation, people's health can also be affected, and the risk of heatstroke increases.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav’s grand reception at 'The Centrum' in Lucknow:52 dishes to be prepared for 800 guests, from Dhoni-Virat to CM Yogi expected to attend
stories.summary: After marrying his childhood friend Vanshika Singh in Mussoorie on 14 March, Indian cricketer Kuldeep Yadav is set to host a grand reception in Lucknow on 17 March. The celebration will take place at the luxury hotel The Centrum, where elaborate preparations are already underway. Both families have now departed from Mussoorie for the event, while hotel staff in Lucknow are busy finalising arrangements for the high-profile gathering. Sources close to the family and the hotel say the reception is being organised on a scale comparable to a Bollywood or royal wedding, with meticulous planning for the guest list, food menu and décor. Over 800 guests expected at the reception According to sources, arrangements have been made for more than 800 guests to attend the reception. Several prominent figures from cricket are expected to be present, including former India captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni and star players Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma. The guest list also includes Jay Shah, chairman of the International Cricket Council. Several prominent political figures are also expected to attend. Among them are Yogi Adityanath, former Uttar Pradesh chief minister Akhilesh Yadav, Uttar Pradesh Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana and Kanpur MP Ramesh Awasthi. Event expenses cross ₹33 lakh The scale of the reception is reflected in the overall expenditure. Sources say the daily rental for the entire hotel during the event is more than ₹26 lakh. To transform the venue into a royal setting, nearly ₹7 lakh is being spent on flowers, lighting and stage decoration alone. When combined with catering, accommodation and other arrangements, the total cost of the reception exceeds ₹33 lakh. Lavish ‘Platinum’ dinner package To ensure top-tier hospitality for guests, the family has opted for the hotel’s most premium catering option, the Platinum Mix Dinner package. Under this package, each plate costs about ₹5,000 (plus tax). The buffet will feature 52 dishes along with two live cooking stations, offering guests a wide variety of freshly prepared food. The menu includes eight welcome drinks, a vegetarian biryani and three premium ice creams. Guests will also be served 200 ml bottled water from premium brands such as Himalayan Natural Mineral Water or Vedica. The entire dining arrangement will be organised in buffet style, allowing guests to enjoy a wide range of cuisines. About The Centrum hotel Operated by the Mansingh Goel Group, The Centrum is a premium five-star hotel located in Sushant Golf City, close to Lulu Mall. The hotel is known for its luxury facilities, elegant décor and calm atmosphere, making it a preferred venue for high-profile events. It houses the multi-cuisine restaurant Plum, which offers buffet dining and a live kitchen, as well as Dum, famous for traditional Awadhi and Nawabi cuisine. For beverages and coffee, the property features the Pendulum Bar and Aurum. Other amenities include an outdoor swimming pool, Moroccan spa, modern fitness centre and indoor recreation options such as billiards and table tennis. The hotel also offers spacious rooms equipped with high-speed internet, smart TVs, minibars and luxury bathrooms. Located about 15 kilometres from Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport and 16 kilometres from Charbagh Railway Station, the hotel is known for hosting prestigious events away from the bustle of the city centre.

stories.title: UPSSSC invites applications for 929 posts:Assistant Statistics and Research Officer roles in various departments; apply from April 21
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for recruitment to 929 posts of Assistant Statistical Officer and Assistant Research Officer (Statistics) in different state departments. The online application process will begin on April 21 and continue till May 11, while the last date to make corrections and adjust fees is May 18. According to Commission Secretary Avnish Saxena, the recruitment will be carried out across several departments, including State Tax, Forest, Cooperation, Animal Husbandry, Medical and Health, and Irrigation and Water Resources. Out of the total 929 posts, 344 are unreserved, 211 are for Scheduled Castes, 12 for Scheduled Tribes, 300 for OBC, and 62 for Economically Weaker Sections. At the same time, the Commission has also declared the final result of a recruitment exam that had been pending for nearly 10 to 11 years. See this list Result came after 10 years, selection completed for 7 posts UPSSSC has released the final result for the recruitment of 7 posts of Nurse Compounder and Hostel Warden in the Department for Persons with Disabilities. This recruitment was announced in the year 2016, but due to several reasons, the examination and selection process remained pending. The commission declared the final result on Friday. In this, 5 candidates from the unreserved category, 1 from the Scheduled Caste, and 1 from the OBC category have been selected. Regarding the cut-off, it was 48.75 marks for the General category, 39.50 for SC, and 48.25 for OBC. This recruitment process could be completed after nearly 10 years. Result Released After 11 Years, Half the Posts Vacant UPSSSC also released the final result on Friday for the recruitment of 8 posts of Instructor and Stenographer in the Training and Employment Department. The for these posts was issued in the year 2015, but due to several reasons, including the exam and interview not being held on time, the selection process remained pending. In this result, released after nearly 11 years, the commission could not find eligible candidates for all the posts. Only 4 out of 8 posts could be filled. Among the selected candidates, 2 are from the unreserved category, 1 from the Scheduled Caste, and 1 from the OBC category. The remaining posts have remained vacant. Athletics coach to be available after 10 years Youth preparing for athletics in UP will now get a coach after 10 years. UPSSSC has released the recruitment result for one post of Assistant Coach (Athletics) in the Sports Directorate. An for this post was released in 2016, but due to delays in the recruitment process, it took about 10 years for the results to come out. Now, after the completion of the selection process, the department will be able to get an athletics coach.

stories.title: ‘Pawan Singh touched my waist inappropriately’:Career ruined by defamation, Haryanvi actress files complaint with Women’s Commission
stories.summary: Bhojpuri singer and actor Pawan Singh is once again in trouble. Haryanvi actress Anjali Raghav has sent a complaint to the Women's Commission against Pawan Singh for touching her waist. Anjali gathered the courage to complain after the Haryana Women's Commission's strict stance in the case of rapper-singer Badshah. Anjali has also sent evidence related to the matter to the commission via email. Anjali said, That day in Lucknow, Pawan Singh inappropriately touched my waist on stage. This was inappropriate behavior. Not only that, but later, social media and media platforms were systematically used to defame me. Anjali has demanded the commission to remove the objectionable comments made against her on social media. The actress says that because of this, she lost the role of Sita in Delhi Ramlila. On the evening of August 29, 2025, Anjali Raghav and Pawan Singh had a stage performance at a music show in Lucknow. During this performance, Pawan Singh touched Anjali's waist, which was captured on camera. 7 important points of the complaint sent to the commission 1. Remove derogatory posts: Instructions should be given to immediately remove the derogatory posts and false propaganda against me on social media. 2. The role of Sita was taken away: From the age of 16, I used to play the role of Mother Sita in various Ramlilas. Through this, I made my identity. After this controversy, my role in Delhi's Ramlila was taken away. 3. Controversy at Lucknow event: A few months ago, I went to Lucknow for the promotion of one of my songs. There, Bhojpuri singer Pawan Singh touched me on stage without my permission, and his team also made a video of it viral on social media. 4. Raised voice on Instagram, received apology: Breaking my silence, I made information about this incident public through my Instagram account. After this, Pawan Singh publicly apologized to me on social media. At that time, it seemed the matter had settled. 5. PR team continuously threatened: Pawan Singh's PR team continuously threatened me. It was said that my social reputation would be harmed and I would be defamed. Many fake and objectionable posts were made against me. False stories and rumors about me were also spread through some regional media platforms. 6. Claim of Mental Stress and Social Exclusion: Due to these incidents, I had to face mental distress and social humiliation. This also affected my work. I had been playing the role of Mata Sita in Delhi Ramlila for a long time. That role was taken away from me, which was connected to my late mother's last wish. Some people boycotted me and my family, leading to a state of depression. 7. Cyber Police Did Not Take Action: I filed a complaint with the Cyber Police Delhi against the concerned Instagram accounts and media platforms, but the objectionable content has not been removed yet. The commission should immediately remove the objectionable posts and false interviews. Also, a public apology should be arranged from the concerned individuals. Now read... The complete story from touching the waist to trolling Evening of August 29, 2025: Anjali Raghav and Pawan Singh had a stage performance at a music show in Lucknow. During this performance, Pawan Singh touched Anjali's waist, which was captured on camera. Morning of August 30: The video went viral on social media. Anjali reacted for the first time and, through an Instagram story, stated that she was very disturbed mentally. She said that this act was unexpected. Initially, she understood it as a "tag," so she didn't say anything on stage. She announced her decision to leave the Bhojpuri industry. August 30 evening: Anjali's trolling started on social media. Clips of old songs were cut and posted. In these, she was even called a porn star. August 31 morning: Pawan Singh publicly apologised through an Instagram story. He wrote- "My intention was not wrong. If Anjali ji felt bad, I apologize. We are artists and respect each other." August 31 afternoon: Anjali shared that apology and wrote- "Yes, he admitted his mistake and I forgave him." After this, Anjali was pressured by Pawan Singh's PR team to edit the story. She was told to write only "Thank You" instead of "admitted mistake". September 1 2: Within two days, memes, videos, and stories were shared every one to two hours from more than 20 Instagram IDs. In these, obscene comments were made against Anjali. September 3: Anjali approached the Delhi Police. She narrated the events happening with her. She also shared more than 20 Insta IDs with the cyber cell. Who is Anjali Raghav Anjali has made her mark with Haryanvi songs. She has also worked in the Bollywood film Tevar. She has also appeared in the serial 'Carry-Rishta Khatta Meetha'. The song 'Hay Re Meri Moto' brought her worldwide recognition. Anjali has also done many regional music videos. Anjali's live shows are held in Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, and Delhi. Anjali Raghav has also worked with Pawan Gill in the song 'Madam Nache Nache Re Tu To'.
